$comment: Single source of truth for temidayoafonja.com. Section 25 of the production
reconciliation brief. This file is a record, not a build input: nothing reads it at
runtime, because the site has no build step and netlify.toml publishes the repository
root as-is. Its purpose is to give one authoritative place to check a name, a date, a
price or a claim before publishing it anywhere.
Every value here was read out of the pages in this repository on the revision date
below, not supplied from memory. Where a value is an operator decision that is
deliberately not published, it is recorded with published: false and the reason.
If this file and the live site ever disagree, the live site is what visitors see, and
the disagreement is a defect to report rather than a value to copy from here.

career_move_review.name: Career Move Review
career_move_review.label: One to one

replaces.decision: Option A of the website audit dated 2026-09-17, section 9.1. One individual one-to-one advisory service, not two. The Private Read had been live for months with no form, no scheduling link and no page of its own, and a second service five dollars away from it could not be told apart from a price list.
replaces.rule: The two must never both be sold, displayed or described. Every public reference to the Private Capability Position Read as a purchasable one-to-one service has been replaced.
replaces.what_survives: The Capability Position Read remains the name of the METHOD, and is still correct wherever the framework, the Field Kit or the free session describe how the reading is done. Only the paid one-to-one service by that name is retired.

career_move_review.positioning: I help experienced professionals make career pivots and internal moves without starting over.
career_move_review.question_it_answers: Does the experience I have built fit the move I am considering, and where is the actual gap?
underlying_questions: What must you relearn when the context changes?
career_move_review.audience: Experienced professionals, generally with 10 or more years of experience, considering a career pivot, internal move, role change, functional move or industry change.
career_move_review.not_for: Organizational, talent and business leaders. Their route is the Capability Formation Executive Briefing. The individual and enterprise journeys stay separate.
client_provides: One target role, intended move or live career decision
Relevant context about timing and constraints
client_receives: An evidence-based review of what travels, what does not, what can be proved and what must be relearned

operational_promises.reply_to_request: Temidayo replies to every request within two business days.
operational_promises.summary_delivery: You will receive your written Career Move Summary within five business days of the session.
operational_promises.clarification_window: The included clarification follow-up may be used within seven calendar days of receiving the Summary.
operational_promises.rule: These three are commitments, not marketing. State them wherever the service is described and nowhere state anything that contradicts them. They appear on career-move-review.html, for-professionals.html, fieldkit.html, book.html, diagnostic.html and keep-the-proof.html.
operational_promises.supersedes: The CMR-SUMMARY-DELIVERY placeholder marker in career-move-review.html, which held the page open while the turnaround was undecided. Removed 2026-09-18.

price.presentation_rule: One public price. State it plainly and once per context. There is no second price anywhere on the site, and nothing frames $500 as temporary, introductory, discounted or about to change.
forbidden: A pilot, introductory or founding rate
A first-five-clients qualifier of any kind
A second price shown alongside it, whether as a future price, a standard rate or a crossed-out figure
Any urgency, scarcity or countdown around the price
price.history: Superseded a two-tier presentation of $495 for the first five clients and $750 thereafter, which was live on the branch but never published. Operator decision 2026-09-18: one public price, $500, current until explicitly changed.
price.distinct_from_retired_offer: This $500 is NOT the retired Private Capability Position Read, which also carried $500. That service remains retired and must not return. The Career Move Review is a different service with a different scope, a written deliverable and qualification before payment. The shared figure is a coincidence of pricing, not a rename.

approved_wording.heading: What it costs.
approved_wording.not_a_fit_line: If it is not a fit, Temidayo will let you know and, where possible, point you toward a more useful next step.

career_move_review.no_outcome_promise: The Review does not promise that anyone will qualify for, obtain or succeed in a particular role. It reads evidence against an intended move. It does not guarantee the move.

qualification_before_payment.rule: No public checkout button on the page. Payment is never taken before fit is assessed.
sequence: An accepted applicant receives the booking and payment route.
qualification_before_payment.reason: During a five-client pilot a single mismatched client is twenty percent of the evidence base.
qualification_before_payment.payment_route: Not configured. No payment link exists yet and none has been invented or embedded. The accepted-applicant route is handled by Temidayo directly until one is set up.

intake.consent: Explicit, unchecked by default, stamped with POLICY_VERSION exactly as the Career Evidence Starter form does.
intake.resume_handling: The public form takes a LinkedIn URL or a short written summary. It does NOT accept file uploads. The site has no authenticated storage, and a public upload endpoint for resumes would put personal documents somewhere they could be enumerated. Resumes are requested by reply, after acceptance, once there is a named person on the other end.
intake.storage: No resume file, no submission body and no personal detail is written to any public path. Nothing from this form is served by the site.

relationship_to_other_offers.career_evidence_starter: Free and preparatory. Useful before a Review, never required.
relationship_to_other_offers.keep_the_proof: Produces the evidence record. The Review tests that record against a specific intended move. Not a prerequisite.
relationship_to_other_offers.field_kit: Complementary, not sequential. The Field Kit is the method run alone; the Review is the method run with Temidayo against one target role. Neither requires the other.
relationship_to_other_offers.career_decisions: A free three-question check, not a smaller Review and not a duplicate of it.
relationship_to_other_offers.executive_briefing: No relationship beyond one quiet de-routing line for anyone who arrives with an organizational question.
relationship_to_other_offers.purchase_prerequisite: None. A person may request a Career Move Review without having bought Keep the Proof or the Field Kit.

career_move_review.cta_rule: One primary call to action, used consistently. Never 'Book a discovery call'.

launch_gate.rule: The Career Move Review must not be described as launch ready, announced, or linked from any outbound channel until BOTH of the following are true.
blockers: FORMSPREE_CAREER_MOVE_REVIEW is configured in the Netlify environment, Runtime scope, and the site has been redeployed so the function can read it. Until then /api/career-move-review-request returns 503 and the page shows its fallback.
A real end-to-end submission has passed in a controlled deploy preview: form submitted, function reached, destination received it, success panel shown.
launch_gate.resolved_2026_09_18: The Career Move Summary turnaround, previously the third blocker, is now approved and stated on the page.

unresolved.individual_proof: No individual testimonial, outcome or result exists for any individual product, and none may be invented. The page stands on scope and specificity. The pilot is the mechanism for producing evidence.
unresolved.legal_review: docs/legal-review-required.md is parked by operator instruction. A paid one-to-one advisory service with a written deliverable is within what that document was opened to handle. This is a PRE-DEPLOYMENT GATE. The outstanding decisions are listed in docs/career-move-review-deployment.md under Legal review. No legal language has been drafted or invented.

lightning_lesson.removed_from_for_professionals: 2026-09-10, the day after the session ran. The card was deleted by hand, which is the manual retirement described below. With one session left, that page's .session-path grid was changed to a single column so the remaining card is not left at half width; the two-column rule still governs the paid-card grid below it.
lightning_lesson.removed_from_diagnostic: 2026-09-10, on the operator's instruction. diagnostic.html carried an undated Lightning Lesson call to action, the fieldKitBox element, revealed to every individual who completed the diagnostic alongside the Stay or Leave offer. It stated no date, so nothing on it read as false, but its registration link pointed at a session that had passed. The box and the single line of script that revealed it were both deleted. Nothing was repointed: the Stay or Leave box directly below it already carried the live September 23 session, so completing the diagnostic still ends on a session offer.
lightning_lesson.retirement_note: Time-bound, and retired two different ways depending on the page. On for-professionals.html the banner block is self-contained and marked in a comment for deletion when the session passes: that one is manual. On career-decisions.html it is NOT manual and must not be deleted by hand. That page holds the session in a single NEXT_STEP configuration block with an explicit expiry of 2026-09-09T18:45:00-05:00, the end of the session in Central time, and switches itself to the Field Kit at that instant with no deploy and no edit, and does so while the page is open rather than only on the next page load, so a tab left open across the cutoff does not keep showing a dead registration link. To retire it earlier than that, set NEXT_STEP.current to null rather than removing the block.

naming_canon.note: Operator decision. This distinction is load-bearing: a free tool must never be called a Read, and a paid engagement must never be called a Scan or a Diagnostic.

free.name: AI Capability Readiness Diagnostic
free.decision: Kept as an unlisted asset. The page is live and unchanged, retains its noindex, nofollow, and is reachable by anyone holding the URL. It was removed from sitemap.xml on 2026-09-18, which resolves the contradiction of submitting a page to search engines while telling them not to index it. It is deliberately NOT in the navigation, NOT in any footer, and NOT linked from any other page. It was not redirected and not deleted.
free.do_not: Do not add it to navigation or a footer, do not put it back in the sitemap, and do not remove the noindex, without a new operator decision.

instruments.dimensions_note: Density and Optionality are the two scored axes that set quadrant placement. Alumni Capital is read alongside them and does not move the quadrant.

institutional_resilience.approved_construction: The two readings inform it. Neither one produces it, and the four terms are not a causal sequence.
institutional_resilience.note: Density is defined as the concentration of tested judgment; density-forming conditions are what develops it. Institutional Resilience must never be described as being produced by, or as the output of, the two readings.
